page_title: REI 1-2 NAN | Reims v Nantes 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Joseph Okumu (Reims) has received a red card for dissent. He probably didn't measure his words as much as he should have and that got him sent off.
90+4' Joseph Okumu (Reims) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Millot and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' Substitution. Nicolas Cozza did his best and is replaced by Louis Leroux (Nantes).
90+4' Substitution. Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes) has come on for Moses Simon.
90+3' The game has begun to heat up. Cedric Kipre (Reims) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) was quite harsh and Benoit Millot didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
88' It is time for a substitution. Jean-Philippe Gbamin (Nantes) is on for Johann Lepenant.
88' Here is a change. Marcus Coco is going off and Antoine Kombouare gives the last tactical orders to Kelvin Amian (Nantes).
85' The manager makes a subsitution with Zabi (Reims) coming on for Valentin Atangana Edoa.
83' 9:10 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
80' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
80' Nhoa Sangui (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
78' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Sergio Akieme will be replaced by Niama Sissoko (Reims).
76' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
74' Buta (Reims) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Anthony Lopes intercepts the ball.
72' Substitution. Mostafa Mohamed leaves the pitch and is replaced by Dehmaine Assoumani (Nantes).
71' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
70' 1 - 2 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) unleashes a shot straight inside the right post. Good team effort!
69' Reims are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
67' Sergio Akieme (Reims) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
65' Total attempts – 12:8.
63' Luka Elsner has decided to substitute John Joe Patrick Finn and he is replaced by Nhoa Sangui (Reims).
63' Here comes a substitution. Amine Salama is given a rest as he is replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
63' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
62' Nantes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
60' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the middle of the target, but Yehvann Diouf keeps it out.
58' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Nantes comes to nothing.
57' It looks like Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) saw red with that tackle. Benoit Millot won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
55' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
53' Buta (Reims) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag and Reims will take a corner.
51' John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
49' Reims players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
47' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+1' 1 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box from the corner but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:1.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Junya Ito (Reims) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
42' 0 - 1 Matthis Abline (Nantes) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Yehvann Diouf with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
41' Junya Ito (Reims) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
39' Junya Ito (Reims) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
37' Amine Salama (Reims) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
35' Some neat passing and movement from Reims as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

33' Joseph Okumu (Reims) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:3.
29' Nantes hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
27' The corner by Moses Simon (Nantes) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
25' John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
23' Junya Ito (Reims) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' A player from Nantes commits a rough challenge. Benoit Millot blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
20' Referee Benoit Millot reverses his original decision after the VAR review and John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) is free to continue.
19' The Reims players are stunned as referee Benoit Millot changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
18' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Reims using VAR. Let's see what happens.
17' John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
17' John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) is penalised for holding. Benoit Millot signals a set piece. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Nantes.
16' Junya Ito (Reims) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
15' Reims are seeing far more of the ball now.
13' Junya Ito (Reims) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
12' Marcus Coco (Nantes) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
10' The possession of the ball – 52:48.
8' The ball is cleared after Amine Salama (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' A dangerous towering header by Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
6' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Reims.
5' Some patient build-up play from Reims as they look to unlock the defence.
3' Benoit Millot blows his whistle and it's Junya Ito (Reims) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
2' Junya Ito (Reims) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the right post.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Nantes will take the kick-off.
Benoit Millot is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
